about: Phase 1 of 3. Runs BEFORE cred-rename-apply.yml. (a) Golden West's four ASE MIL exhibits leave the titles Sam's 2026-10-31 triage gave them (MAPICI-ASEM1 'MIL3 - Drive Train' and ASEM2 'MIL4 - Chassis' under Automotive Braking Systems, ASEM3 'MIL6' under Advanced Electrical and Electronic Systems, ASEM4 'MIL7' under Heating and Air Conditioning) for the MIL titles kb/cert_naming.py writes; kb/credentials.json already holds their ASE records (same PR), so the revise lane retires the old titles' records rather than moving them, and Sam's 15:47Z Chancellor's Office issuer never reaches MIL7. (b) The three industry-certification exhibits under the A5, A7 and A8 standards folds go to the cert titles: MAPICO-IBS (Mt. San Jacinto, IC-Automotive Brake Systems) to ASE A5 — Brakes, its issuer row from California Community Colleges to ASE so the fold does not append a college as an issuer of the certification (Sam's ruling 1 on issue #3110); MAPICO-IPI (IC-Engine Performance I) to ASE A8 — Engine Performance; MAPICI-A6C9 (Long Beach, Auto 617 Completion, a machine draft no person placed) to ASE A7 — Heating and Air Conditioning, insert-only through the fold's supersede lane. (d) Five titles are left with no exhibit: Automotive Braking Systems, Heating and Air Conditioning, Automotive Air Conditioner, Advanced Electrical and Electronic Systems and Engine Performance 1 (ASE A8 Engine Performance). The fold retires each (the revise lane drops the records of a title left with no raw, receipted in kb/unclassified_fold/<date>/; Automotive Air Conditioner's reviewed record stays orphaned, shown nowhere). Sam's saved rows on them retire here by guarded delete, each with why: once they are gone, cred-rename-apply can no longer carry the MIL exhibits into Brakes (ASE A5 standards) or Heating and Air Conditioning (ASE A7 standards). ORDER: this commit, then the next fold (daily-dashboard or cer-procedures), then cred-rename-apply.yml, then phase 3 (kb/cer_decisions_out/2026-11-11-3). Phase 2 (kb/cer_decisions_out/2026-11-11-2) is independent and may ride with this one. Every replace and retire names its row's own reviewed_at from the conductor's live read of 2026-11-11 20:15Z (kb/cer_decisions_out/2026-11-11/00_fresh_reads.sql); a row saved again since holds the whole commit, and the dry run prints the live stamp. The July reviewed_marker rows (map@rccd.edu) retire with their titles on the conductor's word of 20:15Z.
ruling: Sam Lee, in session 2026-11-11 (SkyTamarind, S638; cpl_memory sam-ase-mil-certs-and-cx-to-standards-2026-11-11, sam-ic-exhibits-go-to-cert-title-2026-11-11, sam-cert-name-first-2026-11-11): 'ASE MIL3 test is the Military Tactical Wheeled Vehicle (TWV) – Drive Train certification... if there are any exhibits with ASE MIL in the title, adjust the canonical title to match the official ASE titles'; an industry-certification exhibit under a '(ASE ... standards)' title goes to the cert title, and ('3 yes') the credit-by-exam exhibits under the A5, A7 and A8 cert titles go to the standards titles; then his authorization the same day for the conductor and COBIx to settle the emptied titles without bringing them back to him. Superseding his own 2026-10-31 to 11-11 saves by his word (CLAUDE.md Rule 8); written by SkyTamarind's worker
